balls.text: there may or may not be a run out on the last all, but the yorker was served nicely and hit into the covers. Sharp throw from the deep, and replays say Buttler has made it in time
finally Shahrukh middles it and it's his first boundary, keeps the 200 hopes alive! Perfect full toss around waist height outside off, smashed to the leg side boundary into the crowd
goes closer to the stumps now with a full toss, doesn't quote middle that swat to wide long on
another wide yorker, another one scythed although this one had a chance of being stopped at point, but Rahane's dive to his left was just not enough. No chance for deep third this time
gets the wide yorker right but Buttler does well to carve it away behind point and deep third sprints to his right to finish with a dive but it's not enough
slow and dipping yorker outside off, digs it out to mid off for one
low full toss on off and it's struck back down to long on. Also a single
really wide outside and Buttler shuffles away to off and almost sweeps that to deep midwicket. Just one
116.8kmh, slow offcutter outside off on length, gently bunted to long on for one
pace off yet again, and it does the trick because Tewatia goes for a big shot on the off side but can't connect well and the reliable Ramandeep gets under it nicely
nails the yorker outside off and Buttler can't do much for it apart from digging it out to off for one
pace off but too full, and Buttler comes down as well to smash that low full toss straight down to the long-off boundary
no room or way to get under the near yorker on the stumps, Tewatia can only punch it back and Arora stops it

taken by Rinku Singh at the cow corner! Dipping full toss around knee height and Gill swats that to leg before Rinku dives forward to pouch that nicely well inside the boundary. The clean catch gets an applause from the bowler while Gill gets an applause from his dugout
on the other side this time, exactly 180 degrees and it's scythed for four Attempted wide yorker is almost a half volley and Gill carves that away wide of point in the gap
slow again but this one is really short and there's nobody at deep square leg. Gill can pull it without any worries and he does well to time that nicely after waiting for the slower one
slow and full delivery is drilled back and Arora does well to get his foot in the way
133.2kmh, slightly wide low full toss outside off, he attempts the reverse paddle and misses
97.5kmh, length ball on middle and leg, tucked to deep midwicket for one
offbreak again, this time he clips it square for one
turns into the batter and he's beaten by the turn to be hit on the thigh
waits for this shorter delivery and nudges it to leg for one
this is almost how he hit the first six tonight, and he does it again! Pitched up, in the arc for Gill and he sends that sailing over deep midwicket with a middled slog sweep
straight on off, punched with some room through extra cover and they take two
tapped to the right of point for a quick single and they make it safely with a wayward through to the keeper

swatted to the leg side, that's four more! It looked like Moeen would get there while running to his right from long-on, but his slide with the legs in front mad it too late. Excellent timing, but from Gill
smoked down the ground for four! Pitched up, Gill doens't even have to move his feet and he bashes that straight back over Varun's head
outside off again, and driven into the covers for one

over the top now, and this one's dropped by long-off running in from the deep. But this was much tougher. Manish Pandey running in, puts in a forward dive and gets the hands under the ball but maybe a split second behind the ball
short and wide, tapped to point and no time to runs
ends the over with a cutter, Buttler goes down the ground by keeping it along the carpet for a single
another slower one outside off, another reverse paddle but this time he can't connect

dropped by Vaibhav Arora! He's having a nightmare of a day in the field. First that misfield and now drops a straightforward catch. Buttler can't connect with these cutters tonight, skies one down the ground and Arora is at mid-off, enough time to go back a few steps which he doesn't, but shells it. What's worse, it pops out and rolls away to the long-off boundary
the reverse paddle this time, doesn't middle another shot behind the wicket but the edge is enough to send it ballooning just over the keeper for four
goes through! The slower offcutter couldn't have been a surprise there for Buttler, but he has missed that while trying to push away from the body without any footwork. Doesn't even get close to it
slow offcutter cuts in sharply from outside off and Gill's scythe gets decent enough bat for a single square of the wicket
confident drive for the full ball with a forward lean, single to deep cover to end the over
short and wide, loose delivery after those dot balls and Buttler gets room for a cut to deep point
gently taps this fuller one on off to cover this time
95.1kmh, looks like that stopped a little before reaching Buttler with a scrambled seam, almost popped it to midwicket but landed before him
turning away now from outside off and Gill cuts that square for one
flat and quick on off, no turn and he taps it back

Buttler is not interested in planting too many trees tonight. He makes it three in a row with an early shuffle to off for the scoop and even though he does't middle it, it's gone through the slip region, fine for four
over the covers and it's a one-bounce four this time! Dances down on his third ball to make it a half-volley and middles that over the infield
shot into the pitch, pulled just wide of midwicket and that's enough to get a boundary because of the massive gap between long-on and deep backward square leg
inner half of the bat first ball for the short of length ball outside off. Looked to play it on off but went to midwicket

Russell has done it, Gurbaz thinks there's an edge while Russell hardly appeals but the batter is walking. It's the golden arm of Russell like someone said recently. He bangs the ball short with seam up outside off, Sai Sudharsan cuts and only gets a faint edge for a regulation catch for the keeper
starts with a short and wide delivery, Gill scythes it away for one
carved into the off side this time just wide of point for one

poor fielding in the deep on leg and that's gone for four! Swept behind square and Arora runs to his left, lazily stretches out with his left arm and even touches the ball but doesn't make any real effort to hold on to that. Boundary
pitched up slightly and smashes that to long-on's left with hard hands. Russell tumbles to keep it to one
leans into the length ball outside off for a single flicked to leg
short on leg now and Sai Sudharsan pulls that away for one more
starts with one at 93kmh outside off, short enough to be punched away for one
slow on length outside off again, and this time Sai Sudharsan's fifty with a single to deep third. This one is off 33 balls

is that the first big shot from Sai Sudharsan? I think so, and it's gone all the way for a six. Short ball angling in, he waits on the back foot for the pivot and helps it along the way for six over fine leg
almost chopped on on 49! Gill waits on the back foot and punches towards cover but only gets an inside edge onto his pad. They run across anyway and it's Gill's fifty off 34 balls
112.6kmh, slow again and outside off, he taps it towards point for an easy single
quick with pace but he uses the angle bit too much and this is a wide down leg
much better slower on on the stumps and with a better length, this time the batter waits and defends
welcome back, Mr Rana! Pace off but the offcutter is overpitched outside off and Sai Su leans into that nicely for a cover drive four
Can't take full toll. Low full toss outside off, he drags this right of the cue end of the blade to deep midwicket
A touch flatter on Gill's pads, he works this towards deep midwicket for a run. Hang on, Narine seems to have overstepped. Yep, the buzzers are off.
Wrong'un on off stump, he defends towards cover
Looking for two and they get two with ease. A touch slower just outside off, he ticks this with soft hands towards midwicket. Aaja, aaja shouts Gill and Sai Sudharsan responds.
Darted in on middle stump at 94kph, he eases this to long-off
Flatter outside off, he punches to extra cover
THUMPED one more time! Dragged down just a touch but this guy is so quick to pick length and then find the gaps. He rocks back and pummels this to the deep square leg fence
Wrong'un again on leg stump, he pushes past the bowler for a run
SLAMMED! Googly but that was too short and too wide well outside off. He goes back and slaps this past midwicket
Flatter outside off, he punches to short extra cover and sets off
Splits the gap! Too short on middle and leg, he waits for it and then pulls this in front of square between deep square leg and deep fine leg
Beaten by  a jaffa and there is a wry smile from Gill. Legspinner that pitches on off and turns away past Gill's outside edge.
That has been pulled with some power but only for a run. Dragged down outside off, he goes back and muscles the pull. Rinku takes a step back as he collects.
A touch slower on leg stump, he turns this towards midwicket as Narine and Gurbaz sprint behind the ball
Easy one shouts Gurbaz but the batters have other ideas. They rush back for two. Was fired on a length on leg stump, he works this to deep backward square leg with soft hands.
Flatter 92kph length ball on leg stump, he can't work that away and works it on the pad
Floaty length ball on off stump, Gill eases this to long-on
On a length on middle stump turning into Sai Sudharsan who works this to deep midwicket
Gets some good bounce right away on the length ball outside off turning away from Gill. He drives firmly to deep cover
Angles the length ball outside off, Gill drives with an open face of the bat to the left of deep point for a run
Flatter on off, he works this towards deep midwicket with soft hands and some excellent running gives them a couple
Quicker outside off, he pushes to the right of the bowler who intercepts

WRISTY GILL! That is such a top shot! Flighted fuller length well outside off, it was quite close to the tramline in fact. Gill unleashes a flick of the wrists and sends the sweep to the right of long-on
After the power, here's the deft touch. Floated outside off, he stays back and waits... and waits before playing the late cut just past Gurbaz
FETCH THAT! Floated on off stump, he jumps down the track, goes across the line and whacks him miles over deep midwicket.
Stifle short outside off, he pulls but can't beat short midwicket Gurbaz yells a 'no run' from behind the stumps before the batters could
Flatter and on a length on off stump, he punches this firmly to mid-off and Russell, with creaky knees and all has to bend and intercept
Fired it at 95kph on middle stump, he clips this to the left of mid-on and they take a run
Darted in on Gill's pads at 106.7kph, he ticks this to short fine leg
Gets the ball on a length just outside off, he works this to short midwicket
Gives some width early to Gill and he won't miss out. Was short and a tad wide, he slaps this past a diving Ramandeep at backward point
Short of a good length on middle and leg stump, he flicks this to midwicket.
Goes fuller with the ball seaming in a touch around off stump, he punches to mid-on and sets off for a quick single
slower offcutter at 111.2kph outside off. He punches to deep point for a run
Short of a length just around off stump, he goes back and taps this to point with a slight open face of the bat
Short, wide and punished.  He gets in position early and thumps the cut past point. The ball races away
Finally a boundary for Gill, his first of the night, off his 12th ball.  Some width on offer from Rana and Gill cashes in. Carves him over covers for another four.
Goes on a length well outside off, Gill shoulders arms. That was well outside the tramline
Stifle short outside off, Sai Sudharsan stays back and punches this neatly but can't beat extra cover
A bit of turn as Moeen goes slower through the air. Was on a length outside off, he pushes back to the bowler
Fired on a length outside off, he sweeps again and once again mistimes this to deep midwicket
Dragged but straight to short midwicket. Gill is getting a touch antsy. Was floated outside  off, he sweeps but can't beat Russell
Darted outside off, he shimmies down the track and punches to the left of Moeen who makes a good stop
Fired in at 89kph on off stump, he pushes to extra cover and they take another quick run
Angles the length ball on off stump, he pushes towards covers and sets off
SCORCHING cover drive and Sai Sudharsan's strike rate has taken off. On a length outside off, he drives on the up through covers with elegance, panache and all that jazz.
Rising good length ball on off stump, he turns this to midwicket and takes a quick run
Arora goes a touch fuller around off stump, he pushes towards cover with soft hands and sets off
Nicely done.  Angles the good length ball across Sudharsan outside off, he waits for the ball and opens the face of the blade past short third for his second four in a row

Shapes the length ball on off stump, Gill punches this to mid-on and sets off. There is a direct hit but Gill was home, He will have to be careful with his running. He was run out just in the last match
There's the first boundary of the night and it comes from Sudharsan's blade. Stifle short outside off, he hops back and cuts this through cover to get GT's boundary counter running.
Both batters a touch restrained so far. Tossed up on the fuller side at 89kph outside off, he pushes all along the ground to long-on
Gently floated at 85.3kph on off and middle stump, Sudharsan presents the full face of the bat and eases to long-off
Shortens the length just a touch outside off, Gill eases to long-on
Floated on a length at middle stump, Sudharsan works this neatly to deep square leg for a run
Quicker length ball at off stump, he pushes to point and searches for a run. Is sent back quickly
Angles the good length ball across Sudharsan outside off stump. He bunts this to cover-point for a run. Tidy over from Arora.
Tucked away to deep midwicket for a run. Goes for the inswinger at 125.3kph on off and middle stump. He clips this neatly to Ramandeep
Shimmies down the pitch to the 130.5kph length ball outside off and punches to mid-off
Goes a touch fuller in length outside off stump at 125kph. Gill stretches forward and drives to cover
Gentle length ball at 131kph on off stump. Gill gets right behind it and defends back to the bowler
On a length around middle stump, Sudharsan pushes at it and gets it off the inside half of the blade to the on-side
A hint of swing but the line is well outside off as Sudharsan shoulders arms. Called a wide.
a yorker to end the game and it's bunted down to long on for a single
tries to go the other side now with a reverse scoop but doesn't middle it at all
Raghuvanshi is batting in a different match and on a different track against a different team. He shuffles across to off and scoops that from bottom to top, over the fine leg boundary for six
138.5kmh, short again outside off, he connects this time for a single to deep cover even as Ishant slips in his follow through
short of length outside off, he swings for the off side and misses
Rinku swings wildly for another leading edge and this time Gill takes it nicely. Skies that one on the off side and Gill runs and runs to his left from cover to get under it nicely
ends the over with a smart and slow bouncer outside off, Raghuvanshi wants to ramp it away but misses
on the pads now, Rinku misses the swing on the leg side now but they go across for a leg bye

leading edge flies over the short third fielder and that's another four! Rink swung with a horizontal bat after Siraj pitched it only a bit short, top edge from outside off, and it went high over short third for four
towards leg this time and he tucks it off the hips for one
makes room and he's done it again! Scythes the short of length ball behind square on the off side, though the deep third region for four
a full toss to start the over that's punched towards long off and a bit of a fumble gives them a second
stays back and clips the straight ball on the stumps to leg for one
the wrong'un outside off and he pulls it down to long on for one

taken at long on but SRK has stepped over the rope! He is covering his mouth in disbelief himself because he did very well to take the catch in the end but just stepped over. Rinku swung down the ground, got the distance too but SRK is quiet tall and caught it over his head, but...
way shorter on the stumps, keeps low as well and he does well to bunt it away to leg
turning into him and nudges it square this time with the turn for two more
pitched up slightly and Raghuvanshi goes down quickly to sweep that away behind square in the gap for four

surprises Rinku with a pace on delivery at 137.7kmh, a bouncer down leg that he can't connect with. Rinku thinks it's a wide either down leg or for the height, let's see. Pitching outside leg, and that's gone just over the line of Rinku's front leg as he tried to hook. The height seems fine from here so not called a wide
looks to cut that again, only manages some bat towards point and gets one
a neat-looking back foot scythe for the short of length ball and he's started with a boundary behind square first ball
lofted down the ground, no way he has middled that slow offcutter that had no pace at all, and long on runs in for a simple catch. Job done by SRK
short of length on the stumps and Moeen defends it back

144.5kmh, slams it back to the bowler and Prasidh has taken a stunning return catch but reacted as if he's just bowled another delivery! Almost pitched up, drilled back by Ramandeep around Prasidh's shins and he goes low with barely any reaction time to pouch that
gets a googly first ball and he nudges it to leg for one
and it's all over for Russell! He's been swinging again and again, hardly connecting, miscuing shots, and this time he misses completely after stepping out and it's an easy stumping for Buttler
he can't connect again! The length ball goes straight after pitching outside off, Russell swings and misses
short ball on the stumps, stays low, and he's managed to place it in the gap on the square boundary. Just beats the dive in the deep for the man under the orange cap
swings big down the ground for the length ball outside off, misses that one without much turn and it's another dot
starts with a googly that turns in sharply and beats Russell comprehensively. He's stunned!
full toss on the stumps, and he can't put it away, would you believe it. Bashes it down to Siraj at long on for one
connects this time by opening up his stance again, but not the distance he wanted. Still he's sent that along the ground in the gap wide of long-on and it beats Siraj's dive in the deep for four
144.1kmh, he swings for the hills and the length ball seams in sharply from outside off. Beaten by movement off the pitch with the wobbly seam
bangs in the short ball with two fielders in the deep on leg behind square and Russell lets it go. One for the over
nice and quick on off stump now, stifles him for room and Rinku taps it to cover for one
angles it away from the batter with a length delivery, pace off and beaten
oh, sharp turn in towards the stumps from way outside off, he adjusts and cuts it square for one
swings big for the length ball outside off, only an inside edge to deep midwicket
floats it up way outside off, another wide left alone
angles it in towards the stumps now, he respectfully blocks
really wide, turning away further and called wide
quite wide to Rinku as well outside off, punched to deep point. One more
outside off and turning away, uses hard hands to slap it to deep point
keeps a little low on the stumps, Rinku pulls it away for one

and he finishes the over off with a towering six! Generously tossed up way outside off, half-volley, and Russell is not going to let that go. Goes big downtown, over long-off and it's into the crowd. They've come alive all of a sudden, KKR and the crowd
wide again, this time Russell frees his arms and smashes that straight back, almost taking the umpire's head along the way for a boundary
outside off and he drives it straight to cover along the ground

goes for the big shot and perishes! Rahane jumps out of the crease, Washy pitches it wide and quick way outside off, Rahane throws his bat at it and barely tries to come back in the crease. Buttler does well to stump him quickly
pushed down the ground wide of long-off and they comes back quickly for the second
whips this one against the turn to leg for his fifty, Rahane, off 36 balls, only a bit slower than Gill's and Sai Sudharsan's
falls just short of deep midwicket! Rahane desperately pulls the short ball that's not very short, doesn't get it to go all the way, and Sai Sudharsan hares in, dives forward but it's not enough
quicker at 94.7kmh, just outside off, and Rinky sweeps and misses. Beaten by pace
lunges forward and pushes the ball down to long on for one
turning in and he clips it square to get off the mark
finds deep midwicket! He goes for the big shot on the leg side, doesn't connect well at all and deep midwicket comes in a few yards for a straightforward catch
comes down the track and the bowler replies with a ball on the pads, he chips it down over the bowler's head for two
slow length ball on off, driven square for one
lunges forward on of to drive that into the covers for one. Keeps strike
Rahane breaks the shackles again! Reaches out for the ball and slog sweeps that into the crowd on the leg side for a clean six
flat towards the stumps and he manages to bunt it down to long on just in time
what a delivery! Turn for the flat delivery on off, and it squares up the tall batter completely, he has not clue and can only manage a smile after being beaten
on middle and leg this time, clipped to leg for one
oh, what a shot! Waits in the crease for this well outside off and lofts that over the covers inside out for a one-bounce four
Slightly dragged down on off as Venkatesh hops back and pulls to the left of long-on. Shahrukh Khan dives and saves two more. No boundary since the fifth over for KKR
Slower through the air and outside off. He gets decent spin into Venkatesh, who has to adjust and defends
Angles the length ball at 101.9kph on off as Rahane bunts this to long-on
Floated outside off, he prods forward and chips this inside-out over extra cover. Washington fumbles and concedes an extra run
A hint of grip for Sai Kishore on the length ball on off. Venky Iyer whisks this to long-on
Brings the stumps into play right away. Flatter on off stump, he tucks this towards short midwicket
Backs away to throw Washy off his lengths and then gets back into normal batting stance on leg stump as he clips the length ball on middle and leg to the left of long-on for a couple of runs
Darted in on middle and leg, flicked to deep midwicket

Short and wide outside off, he carves this away past short extra cover. That looked to be going for a certain four before Rashid intercepts haring across to his right from deep cover and putting in a dive
Flatter length ball at 101.6kph on middle and leg, he flicks this to deep midwicket for a run
That kept low outside off. Angles this across Rahane outside off, he has to adjust with the low bounce and pats to extra cover
Darted in on off stump first up. Iyer ticks this to the on-side for a quick run
Fired in on leg stump. Iyer looks to pull that away, misses again as the ball hits his pad and goes towards short fine leg
Quicker length ball on middle, he defends
Fired in on a length on middle, he works this to deep midwicket
Darted in on off, he defends this back to the bowler
Flatter outside off, he carves this away to deep point

Huge appeal for lbw, not given. Rashid is pleading Gill to take the review and he convinces him... at the last second.  Was a flatter length ball on leg stump. Iyer looks to work this to the on-side and misses. He is hit on the higher part of his left pad. Where did that pitch and was it high? No bat, on we go. Pitching in line, impact in line, but the ball would have just trimmed the top of the middle bail. The umpire's call stands.
Short again, and Iyer didn't know much about that as he almost chops it on. Rising back of a length ball on middle, he plays this close to leg stump and Rahane sprints through
Good length ball on middle and leg, he works this to deep backward square leg
How's that missed the off pole? Prasidh goes fuller just outside off. Rahane looks to go down the ground, but is surprised by the length. The ball goes under his bat
A touch slower at 123.5kph on the pad of Venky Iyer, who works this to deep backward square leg for a run
Sharp good length ball on leg stump. Venky Iyer looks for a flick and misses. Is hit on the pad
Back of a length ball outside off, he carves this to deep point who collects it on the bounce
Banged in short just outside off, Rahane sways outside the line and that was too short. Called a wide.
Pushes the length ball quicker just outside off, he looks for a sweep, misses and is rapped on the pad. Think Iyer was just struck outside the line there
On a length on the stumps, he flicks to midwicket
Flatter and fuller outside off, he drives and gets a thick inside-edge onto pad with the ball going towards mid-off

A wicket on the the third ball for Rashid. Not his best ball, any stretch of the imagination. But the W is all Rashid will care about. Short of a length ball down leg asking to be hit. Narine pulls it, but right of the bottom of the bat and straight to square leg. Rashid has a smile on his face, and why not!
A tad bit slower at 86kph on a length on off as he works this to deep midwicket
Flatter legbreak outside off, he punches to point
135kph back of a length ball shaping away from Narine well outside offstump. He sways outside the line of that.
Banged in short following Narine who is backing away big time again. The batter has to take evasive action

Mistimed and goes to deep midwicket on the bounce. Siraj stumbles in his follow-through and is lying sprawling on the floor. Has he hurt himself? Nope just stretches his leg and he looks good to continue. Was a length ball on off and middle. He was looking for a pickup shot over the fence, but splices it instead
A lifter and Rahane is beaten. Was a pacy short of a good length ball at 135.5kph on off stump that Rahane looked to carve over covers. Gets nowhere near it
Pace off but that's down leg and they rush through for an extra run. That was a slower ofcutter down leg.

Backs away and tonks this with disdain. A length ball on middle and leg stump. Narine backs away at the the last moment, frees his arms and sends this soaring over the deep extra cover fence for the first six of KKR's innings.
A thigh-high full toss and Narine finally gets him away. Misses his mark completely on off stump as Narine backs away and heaves this to the left of deep midwicket
UP AND OVER! On a length around off stump. He stays still and gently lofts Prasidh over mid-off. Minimum of follow-through and a top result.
Looks for a wild across the line waft, but can't connect. It was in his slot just outside off, but I think Rahane just went too hard at it.
Slapped straight over the bowler's head. Back of a length ball just outside off and he dismisses this with a flat bat for four
Fullish in length now on the stumps, he chips this to long-on
Oh, that's a rising hard-length delivery at 142.3kph around off. Narine steps away looking to scythe him away. Misses again
Big swing and miss. Was a pacy length ball at 144kph outside off. He gets his front leg out of the way and backs away. Can't lay a bat on that
That's so smartly ramped. Short of a length ball just outside off, he arches back and deftly gets this in between the 'keeper and short third to end the over on a high
Another solid on the up punch but for no runs. Was a length ball just around off stump, he presents the full face of the bat but can't get past mid-off
Sharp short of a good length ball just outside off, he plays a short arm jab to mid-on. Doesn't time it once more.
Picked up for a couple of runs and Washy does well to save two. Back of a length outside off, he splices it over midwicket, and Washy haring across from deep square leg does well
On a length around off and middle, he ticks this towards midwicket
Goes fuller outside off stump. Narine, who is leg side of the ball drives on the up to the left of cover point for a run
Fullish-length ball around off stump, Rahane presents the full face of this bat and drives to mid-off
A wristy flick gives Rahane his first boundary for the night. Angling in on leg stump, he picks this exquisitely over square leg for a four
Angles the length ball into Narine following him and cramping him for room. That seems to be the plan from both bowlers. Narine looks to swing this away, misses and is hit on the pad
Hint of movement for Ishant back into Rahane who defends towards slip
Back of a length ball on leg stump, he backs away again and pulls to deep backward square leg
In the arc for Narine and away the ball goes. Ambling in on a length on middle stump, Narine clears his front leg and lifts him over mid-on
Good length ball outside off with a hint of nibble away from Rahane outside off. He shoulders arms

Oh, that's plumb, isn't it? Siraj is convinced and the umpire's finger is up in an instant. Will Gurbaz review? Yes, he does after a quick chat with Narine. Was a length ball that pitched on off and shaped back into Gurbaz catching him in front of middle. Gurbaz looks to pick this to the on-side, misses and is trapped in front. No bat says the third umpire, and the tracker confirms the ball would crash into leg stump. Gurbaz goes and takes a review with him
Follows Narine who is camped outside leg stump and backs away as well. He wears it on the pad with the ball going towards square leg
Good length ball just outside off and Gurbaz is off with a quick single to point
Nearly a wicket second ball. Short of  a length ball outside off, he charges down the track looking to pull that away. Can only manage a thick inside-edge that goes perilously close to off stump
